prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Sugar Land, Texas, and has knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1207; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision you were involved in while making a left turn in Sugar Land, Texas. Do you understand that this conversation is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Please state your full address for the record.

A: I'd rather just give the city, Sugar Land. I can provide the full address later if you need it.

Q: That's fine. Can you walk me through what happened at the intersection?

A: I was driving straight through a green light and then decided to turn left into the parking lot of a shopping center. I put on my signal and waited for a gap in oncoming traffic.

Q: How long did you wait before you started your turn?

A: Maybe five or six seconds. There was a line of cars coming toward me, and I let a few pass.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before you began to turn?

A: I saw headlights further back, but I thought there was enough room. I guess I misjudged the distance.

Q: Where did the impact occur on your vehicle?

A: The front passenger side of my car was hit, and then my car spun a little. My knee hit the dashboard pretty hard.

Q: Can you describe your knee injury and any treatment you've received so far?

A: My right knee swelled up almost right away. I couldn't put much weight on it, so I went to urgent care that evening. They took X-rays and told me to see an orthopedist. I've had two physical therapy sessions and I'm still in a brace.

Q: Have you missed any work because of the injury?

A: Yes, I've been out for about a week and I'm waiting to hear whether I can return to light duty.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I'm sorry for the accident and I want to cooperate fully. I'm willing to provide my medical records.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
